as_told.title: Atomic Energy Commission records concluding UFOs are extraterrestrial, possibly tied to AFSWP crash records

plain: An online UFO researcher known as UAPGerb told Jesse Michels in 2026 that a man named Dylan Borland had said on another podcast, Weaponized, that DTRA, a Pentagon agency that deals with weapons of mass destruction, held old records from the Atomic Energy Commission, the agency that once ran America's nuclear programme. According to Borland, those records concluded that UFOs are vehicles from beyond Earth. UAPGerb also suggests the records may tie to crash files from AFSWP, the military's early nuclear weapons office, and to Sandia, a nuclear weapons laboratory, which would mean the nuclear world reached that conclusion long ago.
